topic: Choosing facility log vs version data
summary_markdown: A discussion occurred regarding the source of comprehensive facility history: `facility_log` or `facility_version`. [p1] explained that `facility_log` explicitly records changes upon saving, while `facility_version` captures all changes via an update trigger. However, [p1] noted that `facility_log` is generally used across the system, with versions currently reserved only for approved frames. Ultimately, it was decided that version data will be used to ensure completeness, particularly since campaigns rely on versions.
decisions: Use facility version data for comprehensive history, especially for campaign reporting.
